n-k-k2-01.title: Sheegasho ku saabsan fasalka oo dhan
n-k-k2-01.goal: Isticmaal is-barashooyinka sida caddayn si aad u go'aamiso haddii weedh ku saabsan qof walba run tahay, eeg inta ka-reeban ay jebiyaan, oo qor weedh ku habboon caddaynta.
n-k-k2-01.material:
Fasalkaagu wuxuu leeyahay koox sheeko. Fasalku wuxuu leeyahay afar arday. Mid walba wuxuu qoray is-barasho gaaban oo ku saabsan cunto. Kadib 수진 wuxuu qoray weedh ku saabsan fasalka.

민호: 저는 김치를 좋아해요. 매일 먹어요.
에밀리: 저는 김치를 안 좋아해요. 불고기를 좋아해요.
지아: 저는 김치를 좋아해요. 그런데 매운 김치는 못 먹어요.
토마스: 저는 김치를 좋아해요. 지난주에 처음 먹었어요.

수진: 우리 반 네 명은 모두 김치를 좋아해요.

(모두 = dhammaan.)
n-k-k2-01.thinking.1: Hal tusaale lid ku ah ayaa jebiya 'dhammaan'
n-k-k2-01.thinking.2: Kala saarista 'ma jecla' iyo faahfaahin kale
n-k-k2-01.s.s1.prompt: 수진 wuxuu sheeganayaa in DHAMMAAN afarta arday ay jecelyihiin kimchi. Weedhda ardayga kee ayaa muujinaysa in sheegashadeedu aanay run ahayn?
n-k-k2-01.s.s1.hint.0: Arday kasta, go'aami haddii weedhdu kuu sheegayso inuu ama ay jecelyahay kimchi.
n-k-k2-01.s.s1.hint.1: Hayso kaliya weedhaha si toos ah uga jawaabaya 'Ma qofkan wuu jecelyahay kimchi?', oo barbardhig weedhda 수진.
n-k-k2-01.s.s1.r.a: Cunista maalin walba waxay taageertaa sheegashada; ma muujin karto in qof uusan jeclayn kimchi.
n-k-k2-01.s.s1.r.b: Eeg is-barashada oo dhan: 지아 sidoo kale wuxuu leeyahay waa jecelyahay kimchi. Ma cuni karto nooca xoogga leh, taas oo aan ahayn isku mid in aan la jeclayn kimchi.
n-k-k2-01.s.s1.r.d: Cunista markii ugu horreysay usbuucii hore waxba kama sheegayso haddii uu jecelyahay.
n-k-k2-01.s.s1.explain: Kaliya 에밀리 ayaa ku jawaabta 'Do you like kimchi?' maya. Sheegasho ku saabsan qof kasta waxaa jebiya hal qof oo ku khilaafa. Weedhaha kale waxay ku saabsan yihiin intee, intee ay xanuun badan tahay ama goorta, ma aha jeclaanta.
n-k-k2-01.s.s2.prompt: Weedha 수진 waxay leedahay 모두 (dhammaan). Imisa ka mid ah afarta saaxiib fasal ayaa ahaan lahaa inay ku khilaafaan si weedhdeeda ay u noqoto been?
n-k-k2-01.s.s2.hint.0: Qiyaas fasalku wuxuu leeyahay 100 arday. Imisa qof oo kimchi neceb ayaad u baahan tahay inaad hesho?
n-k-k2-01.s.s2.hint.1: 'Dhammaantood way jecel yihiin' waa run marka cidina laga tagin oo keliya. Tiri imisa ka reebanaan ayaa jebiya.
n-k-k2-01.s.s2.r.a: Laba waa ka badan intii loo baahnaa. 'Dhammaan' wuxuu ballan qaadaa qof kasta.
n-k-k2-01.s.s2.r.c: Saddex waa ka badan intii loo baahnaa. 'Dhammaan' wuxuu ballan qaadaa qof kasta.
n-k-k2-01.s.s2.r.d: Afar aad bay uga badan yihiin intii loo baahnaa. 'Dhammaan way jecel yihiin' marka hore ayuu fashilmaa hal qof markuu jeclayn.
n-k-k2-01.s.s2.explain: 'Dhammaan' wuxuu ballan qaadaa wax ku saabsan qof kasta, sidaas darteed hal ka reeban ayaa ku filan inuu jebiyo. Weedh sida '대부분' (inta badan) waxay ka badbaadi kartaa dhawr ka reeban.
n-k-k2-01.s.s3.prompt: Qor HAL weedh Kuuriyaan ah oo edeb leh oo ku saabsan kimchi iyo afarta saaxiib fasal oo run u ah afarta isku soo bandhig.
n-k-k2-01.s.s3.hint.0: Marka hore go'aami imisa ka mid ah afarta ayaa jecel kimchi, kadibna qor weedh run u ah kooxdaas sax ah.
n-k-k2-01.s.s3.hint.1: Hubi weedhaada ka hor 에밀리's soo bandhigga ka hor intaadan dhammaysan.
n-k-k2-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma weedhaydu run u tahay AFARTA soo bandhig dhammaantood, oo ay ku jirto 에밀리's?
n-k-k2-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma iska ilaaliyey 'dhammaan' haddii aanan magacaabin ka reebanaanta?
n-k-k2-01.s.s3.modelNote.2: Wuu tiriyaa halkii uu odhan lahaa 'dhammaan'.

n-k-k2-02.title: Ma qoraalku wuxuu waafaqsan yahay wada hadalka?
n-k-k2-02.goal: Is barbar dhig soo koobid qoran iyo wada hadalka asalka ah, hel sadarrada beddelay faahfaahin, sheeg nooca faahfaahinta isbeddelay, oo qor soo koobid la saxay.
n-k-k2-02.material:
민수 iyo 지나 waxay qorsheeyaan Sabtida wada hadal ahaan. Kadibna 지나 ayaa qoraal u qorta hooyadeed.

민수: 지나 씨, 토요일 오후 두 시에 학교 앞에서 만나요.
민수: 영화는 세 시 반에 시작해요. 영화를 보고 저녁을 먹어요.
민수: 저녁을 먹고 아홉 시에 집에 가요.
지나: 네, 좋아요!

(앞 = hor yaal. 집에 가요 = guriga tag.)
n-k-k2-02.thinking.0: Hubinta soo koobid iyadoo la eegayo isha
n-k-k2-02.thinking.1: Ogaanshaha meelaha iyo waqtiyada la beddelay
n-k-k2-02.prereq.0: Wuxuu yaqaan erayada waqtiga Kuuriyaanka (두 시, 아홉 시)
n-k-k2-02.s.s1.prompt: 지나 ayaa qoraal u qorta hooyadeed. Qaar ka mid ah sadarrada ma waafaqsana wada hadalka. Dooro hal sadar oo qoraalka ah oo aan waafaqsanayn wada hadalka.
n-k-k2-02.s.s1.hint.0: Ka dhex gudub qoraalka sadar sadar oo hel isla faahfaahinta wada hadalka: yaa, maalinta, meel, waqti.
n-k-k2-02.s.s1.hint.1: Sadar kasta, dheh haddii wada hadalku bixiyo meel ama waqti, oo is barbar dhig erayada mid mid.
n-k-k2-02.s.s1.explain: Laba sadar ma waafaqsana wada hadalka. Sadarka 2 wuxuu leeyahay waxay kulmayaan hor yaal bandhigga filimka, laakiin 민수 wuxuu qoray 학교 앞 (hor yaal dugsiga). Sadarka 5 wuxuu leeyahay 여덟 시 (saacadda 8), laakiin 민수 wuxuu qoray 아홉 시 (saacadda 9). Sadarrada 1, 3 iyo 4 way waafaqsan yihiin.
n-k-k2-02.s.s2.prompt: Sadarrada qoraalka ee khaldan waxay ka duwan yihiin wada hadalka laba hab oo kala duwan. Lammaanahee ayaa ah?
n-k-k2-02.s.s2.hint.0: U kala saar faahfaahinta qorshaha kooxo: yaa, maalinta, meel, waqti.
n-k-k2-02.s.s2.hint.1: Labada koox ee kee ayaa ka kooban faahfaahinta u beddelay inta u dhexeysa wada hadalka iyo qoraalka?
n-k-k2-02.s.s2.r.a: Maalinta (토요일) waa isku mid wada hadalka iyo qoraalka.
n-k-k2-02.s.s2.r.b: Qofka (민수) iyo maalinta (토요일) waa isku mid wada hadalka iyo qoraalka.
n-k-k2-02.s.s2.r.d: Qofka (민수) waa isku mid wada hadalka iyo qoraalka.
n-k-k2-02.s.s2.explain: Qoraalku wuxuu beddelaa meesha ay kulmaan (영화관 halkii 학교) iyo goorta ay guriga tagaan (여덟 시 halkii 아홉 시). Yaa iyo maalinta waa sax.
n-k-k2-02.s.s3.prompt: Mar kale qor qoraalka hooyada Kuuriyaan edeb leh oo sax ah (2 ama 3 weedhood oo gaaban). Isticmaal wada hadalka si aad u bixiso meesha kulanka, waqtiga kulanka iyo waqtiga ay guriga tagto.
n-k-k2-02.s.s3.hint.0: Marka hore liis garee saddexda faahfaahin: meesha ay kulmaan, goorta ay kulmaan, goorta ay guriga tagto.
n-k-k2-02.s.s3.hint.1: Koobiyee faahfaahin kasta farriimaha 민수 oo waqti kasta la ilaali qorshihiisa, kadibna ku dar dhammaadyada edebta ah (-요).
n-k-k2-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma meel iyo waqti kasta oo qoraalkayga ku jira waxay waafaqsan yihiin wada hadalka?
n-k-k2-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma hooyaday ogaan lahayd meesha iyo goorta ay i sugayso?
n-k-k2-02.s.s3.modelNote.1: Tirooyinka iyo 랑 waa fiican yihiin.

n-k-k2-03.title: Casumaad leh daldalool
n-k-k2-03.goal: Go'aami xaqiiqooyinka ka maqan casumaad gaaban, ogow in jawaab aan cadayn weli aanan ku filnayn, oo weydii wixii aad u baahan tahay.
n-k-k2-03.material:
Usbuucii hore waxaad kula kulantay 지호 fasal luqad. Maanta fariin ayaa kuu soo dirtay. Waligaa ma tagin gurigiisa.

지호: 토요일에 우리 집에서 파티를 해요. 꼭 오세요!

(꼭 = fadlan hubi inaad timaaddo.)
n-k-k2-03.thinking.1: Kala sooca waxa loo baahan yahay iyo waxa wanaagsan in la ogaado
n-k-k2-03.thinking.2: Jawaabo aan cadayn oo u eg jawaabo
n-k-k2-03.prereq.0: Wuxuu yaqaan erayada su'aasha aasaasiga ah (몇 시, 어디)
n-k-k2-03.prereq.2: Wuxuu odhan karaa 'waan imaan doonaa' iyo 'mahadsanid' Kuuriyaan fudud oo edeb leh (갈게요, 고마워요), oo lagu sharaxay tilmaamaha
n-k-k2-03.s.s1.prompt: Waxaad rabtaa inaad tagto. Su'aalo noocee ah ayaad tahay inaad weydiiso ka hor intaadan runtii gaarin xafladda? Dooro dhammaan kuwa aad runtii u baahan tahay.
n-k-k2-03.s.s1.hint.0: Qiyaas waa Sabtida subaxdii oo aad rabto inaad baxdo. Maxaa ku joojin lahaa inaad baxdo?
n-k-k2-03.s.s1.hint.1: Kala saar su'aalaha: kuwee ayaa kaa caawiya inaad gaarto, kuwee-na waa wanaagsan in la ogaado oo keliya?
n-k-k2-03.s.s1.r.b: Imisa martida ayaa imaanaysa ma beddelo inaad heli karto meesha ama gaari karto waqtigii.
n-k-k2-03.s.s1.r.d: Waa waxtar leh oo edeb leh in la weydiiyo, laakiin waad gaari kartaa adigoon ogayn. Looma baahna inaad gaarto.
n-k-k2-03.s.s1.r.e: Ogaanshaha munaasabadda waxay kaa caawin kartaa dooranaysa hadiyad, laakiin ma kuu sheegto goorta ama halka aad tagto.
n-k-k2-03.s.s1.explain: Fariintu waxay bixisaa maalinta (토요일) laakiin waqti ma bixiso, 우리 집-na ma kuu sheego cinwaanka qof aadan waligaa booqan. Waqtiga iyo meesha waa labada xaqiiqo ee aad u baahan tahay si aad u gaarto.
n-k-k2-03.s.s1.acc.0: Weydiinta waxa la keenayo waa ixtiraam iyo wanaag. Looma baahna kaliya inaad gaarto meesha saxda ah iyo waqtiga saxda ah.
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.prompt: 지호 wuxuu ku jawaabaa su'aalahaaga hal sadar oo keliya: '저녁에 오세요.' Hadda ma ogtahay wax ku filan oo ku saabsan waqtiga?
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.hint.0: Ka fikir imisa saacadood ayuu erayga 저녁 daboolayaa.
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.hint.1: Is weydii: laba marti ma akhrin karaan weedhdan oo ay imaan karaan saddex saacadood kala fog?
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.o.a: Haa. 저녁 waa waqti, sidaas darteed waan imaan karaa wakhti kasta habeenkii.
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.r.a: 저녁 (fiidka) wuxuu daboolaa dhawr saacadood. Haddii aad daahdo, waxaad seegi kartaa bilowga; haddii aad hore u timaaddo, cidina diyaar ma noqon.
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.o.b: Weli maya. 저녁 wuxuu daboolaa dhawr saacadood, sidaas darteed weli waxaan u baahanahay saacadda sax ah.
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.o.c: Haa. Waan ogahay maalinta iyo qaybta maalinta, sidaas darteed waan qorsheyn karaa imaatinkayga.
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.r.c: Maalin iyo qayb maalinta ah weli ma aha waqti imaatin oo sax ah.
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.o.d: Weli maya. 저녁 macnaheedu waa 'casho', sidaas darteed waa inaan weydiiyaa haddii cunto la bixiyo.
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.r.d: 저녁 wuxuu ka dhigan karaa 'fiid' ama 'casho'. Halkan waa eray waqti sababtoo ah 에 iyo 오세요, cuntuna ma kuu sheegto goorta aad imaanayso.
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.explain: 저녁 wuxuu magacaabaa qayb maalinta oo keliya. Si aad u gaarto waqtiga saxda ah weli waxaad u baahan tahay saacadda, tusaale 여섯 시.
n-k-k2-03.s.s3.prompt: Ku jawaab 지호 Kuuriyaan edeb leh.
n-k-k2-03.s.s3.hint.0: Ku bilow adigoo mahadnaq ku sheegaya ama sheegaya inaad imaan doonto (고마워요 = mahadsanid, 갈게요 = waan tegi doonaa).
n-k-k2-03.s.s3.hint.1: Xaqiiqooyinkee liiskaaga su'aalaha hore ayuu qofku u baahan yahay ka hor intaanu guriga ka bixin? Weydii iyaga dhammaadka edebta leh (-요).
n-k-k2-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma waydiiyay labadaba waqtiga IYO meesha?
n-k-k2-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma jawaabtaydu waa edeb ku filan qof aan kulankay usbuucii hore oo keliya?
n-k-k2-03.s.s3.modelNote.2: Dhammaadyada rasmiga ah waa fiican yihiin.

n-k-k2-04.title: Dambiil leh qaanuunno
n-k-k2-04.goal: Akhri dhawr shuruudood oo wada hadal gaaban oo iibsi ah, kadibna dhis in ka badan hal dambiil oo buuxiya dhammaantood oo ka warbixi hal dambiil Kuuriyaan ahaan.
n-k-k2-04.material:
민지: 오늘 시장에서 과일을 사요. 사과는 한 개에 천 원, 귤은 한 개에 오백 원이에요.
민지: 사과도 사고 귤도 사요. 그런데 사과가 귤보다 적어요.
민지: 과일은 모두 일곱 개 이상 사요. 오천 원을 넘으면 안 돼요.

(이상 = tirada ama ka badan. 넘으면 안 돼요 = waa inaan dhaafin. -보다 = ka.)
n-k-k2-04.thinking.1: Hubinta tusaale iyadoo la eegayo dhammaan shuruudaha
n-k-k2-04.thinking.2: Aragtida in xadadku oggolaadaan jawaabo badan
n-k-k2-04.prereq.0: Wuxuu yaqaan tirooyinka ilaa kumanaan (천, 오백)
n-k-k2-04.s.s1.prompt: Fariinta labaad ee 민지, maxay kuu sheegtaa '사과가 귤보다 적어요' dambiisha?
n-k-k2-04.s.s1.hint.0: Hel midhaha mawduuca ah (lagu calaamadiyey 가) iyo midhaha la is barbar dhigayo (lagu calaamadiyey 보다).
n-k-k2-04.s.s1.hint.1: Akhri 적어요 sida 'waa qadar yar' oo go'aami midhaha leh qadar yar.
n-k-k2-04.s.s1.o.a: Waxaa jira tufaax ka badan tangerines.
n-k-k2-04.s.s1.r.a: 적어요 macnaheedu waa 'yar / ka yar'. -보다 wuxuu calaamadeeyaa waxa la is barbar dhigayo, sidaas darteed tufaaxu waa tirada yar.
n-k-k2-04.s.s1.o.b: Waxaa jira tufaax tiro le'eg tangerines.
n-k-k2-04.s.s1.r.b: Weedhdu waxay is barbar dhigtaa laba qadar oo waxay leedahay mid ka yar; ma sheegto inay le'eg yihiin.
n-k-k2-04.s.s1.o.c: Waxaa jira tufaax ka yar tangerines.
n-k-k2-04.s.s1.r.d: Sadarka ka horreeya wuxuu leeyahay 사과도 사고, sidaas darteed tufaaxu waa dambiisha ku jiraa; 적어요 wuxuu leeyahay 'ka yar', ma aha 'midna'.
n-k-k2-04.s.s1.explain: A (사과가) B (귤보다) 적어요 = A waa ka yar B. Sidaas darteed tirada tufaaxa waa ka yar tirada tangerines.
n-k-k2-04.s.s2.prompt: Qof ayaa soo jeediyey 3 tufaax iyo 5 tangerines. Shuruudee ka mid ah shuruudaha 민지 ayay dambiishan jebisaa?
n-k-k2-04.s.s2.hint.0: Hubi shuruudaha mid mid adigoo isticmaalaya tirooyinka 3 iyo 5.
n-k-k2-04.s.s2.hint.1: Shuruudda lacagta, xisaabi qiimaha tufaaxa iyo tangerines si gooni ah, kadibna ku dar.
n-k-k2-04.s.s2.r.b: 3 tufaax waa ka yar 5 tangerines, sidaas darteed shuruudan waa fiican tahay.
n-k-k2-04.s.s2.r.c: 3 + 5 = 8 gabal oo miro ah, taasoo ah 7 ama ka badan, sidaas darteed tani waa fiican tahay.
n-k-k2-04.s.s2.r.d: Dambiishu wuxuu leeyahay tufaax iyo tangerines labadaba, sidaas darteed tani waa fiican tahay.
n-k-k2-04.s.s2.explain: 3 tufaax waxay ku kacaan 3,000 won 5 tangerines-na waxay ku kacaan 2,500 won, wadar ahaan 5,500 won. Taasi waa ka badan 5,000. Saddexda shuruudood ee kale waa la buuxiyey.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.prompt: Hel 3 dambiil oo kala duwan oo buuxiya shuruud KASTA oo ku jirta farriimaha 민지. a = tirada tufaaxa (사과), t = tirada tangerines (귤).
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.hint.0: Marka hore shuruudaha ku dhig erayadaada: tufaax ka yar tangerines, ugu yaraan 7 gabal, ugu badnaan 5,000 won.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.hint.1: Isku day 1 tufaax oo hel tiro tangerines ah oo ka dhigaysa ugu yaraan 7 gabal; kadibna hubi qiimaha.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.hint.2: Lacagta ugu dambeyn hubi: 1,000 x tufaax + 500 x tangerines, kadibna beddel tirada tufaaxa.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.fail.c0: Iibso gabal dhan oo miro ah oo keliya (tiro dhan oo 개).
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.fail.c1: 사과도 사고 귤도 사요: ugu yaraan mid ka mid ah mid kasta.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.fail.c2: 사과가 귤보다 적어요: tufaaxu waa inuu ka yar yahay tangerines.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.ok.c3: 7 ama ka badan oo gabal guud ahaan.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.fail.c3: 일곱 개 이상: ugu yaraan 7 gabal oo miro ah guud ahaan.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.fail.c4: Wadarta waa ka badan 5,000 won (tufaax 1,000 mid kasta, tangerine 500 mid kasta).
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.explain: Tusaale 1 tufaax + 7 tangerines = 4,500 won; 2 + 5 = 4,500 won; 3 + 4 = 5,000 won. Dambiil badan ayaa ku habboon sababtoo ah farriimuhu waxay bixiyaan xadado, ma aha hal dalab oo sax ah.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.because.prompt: Dooro HAL dambiil oo ka mid ah kuwaaga oo ku sheeg 민지 fariin gaaban oo edeb leh imisa tufaax iyo tangerines ayaad iibsan doontaa iyo wadarta qiimaha.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.because.hint.0: Ka qaado hal dambiil liiska kore oo qor labadiisa tiro.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.because.hint.1: Dheh tufaaxa, kadibna tangerines, kadibna wadarta won.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.because.selfAssess.0: Ma tirooyinka fariintayda waxay waafaqsan yihiin hal dambiil oo aan dhistay?
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.because.selfAssess.1: Ma wadarta waa sax (1,000 x tufaax + 500 x tangerines)?
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.because.modelNote.1: Tirooyinka asalka ah waa fiican yihiin.

n-k-k2-05.title: Yaa sameeyay? Weedhdu ma sheegto
n-k-k2-05.goal: Raac wada hadal gaaban oo ka tagaya mawduucyada, ogow sida akhrintaadu ee ku saabsan yaa maxay sameeyay u beddelanto marka macluumaad yimaado, oo dib u qor weedh si cidina u khaldami karin.
n-k-k2-05.material: 하나 ayaa la hadasha saaxiibkeed 준호 usbuuca hore dhammaadkiisa. Kuuriyaan, mawduucu inta badan waa la ka tagaa marka u muuqdo mid cad. Akhri tartiib: sheekadu waxay ku timaadaa saddex qaybood.
n-k-k2-05.thinking.1: Dib u eegidda akhrin marka macluumaad yimaado
n-k-k2-05.thinking.2: Ka dhigidda fariin aan lahayn kala duwanaansho
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.prompt: Akhri qayb kasta, dooro akhrinta u muuqata mid ugu macquulsan, ka dibna sii wad. Jawaabtaadu way beddeli kartaa markaad akhrido wax dheeraad ah.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.hint.0: Go'aami adigoo isticmaalaya waxa aad ilaa hadda akhrisay oo keliya.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.hint.1: Eeg erayada magacaabaya qof iyo falalka aan lahayn qof ku lifaaqan.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.st.0.after: Weedhda labaad mawduuc ma laha. Kuuriyaanku badanaa wuxuu ka tagaa mawduuc ka cad macnaha hareeraha, laakiin halkan walaalka (동생이) waa qofka ugu dambeeya ee la magacaabay 하나-na waa hadlaha, sidaas darteed halkan ma hubin kartid.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Weedhdu waxay leedahay 만들었어요, sidaas darteed qof ayaa sameeyay, laakiin dadka keliya ee sheekada ku jira waa 하나 iyo walaalkeed yar.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.st.1.ask: Yaa u badan inuu sameeyay bibimbap hadda?
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.st.1.after: 하나 waxay u badan tahay inay iyadu laftigeedu sameysay, laakiin waxay ka jawaabtay su'aal ku saabsan xirfadda walaalkeed, sidaas darteed weli waa akhris u badan oo keliya.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.st.1.r.a: 하나 waxay tiraahdaa walaalkeed ma karin karo, sidaas darteed tani ma u badna, laakiin weli ma sheegin yaa kariyay.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Qaybtii ugu horreysay waxay leedahay 만들었어요 (la sameeyay), sidaas darteed qof ayaa kariyay.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Jawaabteedu waxay ku saabsan tahay xirfadda walaalka. Ma sheegto inay wadaagtay karinta.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.st.2.after: 먹었어요 mar kale mawduuc ma laha. Si ugu dabiici badan waa 하나, laga yaabo walaalkeed la socdo. Marka qof si cad loo calaamadeeyo (동생이 했어요), calaamaddu waxay kuu sheegtaa yaa; marka wax aan la calaamadayn, waa inaad isticmaashaa macnaha hareeraha mararka qaarna aad weydiiso.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.st.2.r.b: 하나 waa tan yidhi 제가 만들었어요; wax ma calaamadeeyaan walaalka keligiis inuu yahay kan cunay. 설거지는 동생이 waxay leedahay calaamad, laakiin 먹었어요 ma laha.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.st.2.r.d: 맛있게 먹었어요 wuxuu sheegayaa inay la cunay oo laga raaxaystay.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.reflect: Kuuriyaanku badanaa wuxuu ka tagaa mawduuc marka macnaha hareeraha uu bixiyo, laakiin qofka ugu dambeeya ee aad ka akhrisay had iyo goor ma aha kan sameynaya ficilka xiga. Raadi calaamadaha (이/가, 은/는, 제가) oo ka dhig akhrinta mid furan marka wax aan la calaamadayn. Haddii ay muhiim tahay, weydii.
n-k-k2-05.s.s2.prompt: Dib u qor labada weedhood ee ugu horreeya 하나 Kuuriyaan edeb leh si qofna u qaldi waayo cidda sameysay bibimbap: waxay ahayd 하나 laftigeeda, sida aad ku baratay sheekada. Asal: 어제 동생이 우리 집에 왔어요. 비빔밥을 만들었어요.
n-k-k2-05.s.s2.hint.0: Is barbardhig weedhdaada iyo asalka: macluumaadkee ayaa maqan weedhda labaad?
n-k-k2-05.s.s2.hint.1: Qayb ka dib eray qof (-가 / -이) ayaa muujisa in qofkan uu ficilka sameeyay.
n-k-k2-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Akhristaha ma ogaan karaa yaa sameeyay bibimbap isagoon sheekada eegin?
n-k-k2-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma weli ku sheegay in walaalku yimid gurigayga?
n-k-k2-05.s.s2.modelNote.1: Waxay sidoo kale magacaabtaa qofka aan sameynin.
